profile.visual_desc: Human female with a long blonde ponytail. Wears a red-brown tunic, teal sash, purple baggy pants, and gold-trimmed greaves.
profile.face_cutin_desc: Serene expression with large dark eyes and red lips. Long blonde hair frames the face with a center-parted fringe.
profile.weapon_desc: Gem-tipped wooden staff held in the right hand.
profile.step1_ready: Rear-isometric view facing ↖. Stands with staff resting against the shoulder and arms slightly bent.
profile.step2_windup: Raises staff and left hand high. Body tenses as ponytail lifts, preparing a focused energy strike.
profile.step3_impact: Lunges ↖, thrusting both hands forward. A concentrated blue energy spark emits from the staff tip at the extension's peak.
profile.step4_finish: Holds the forward lunge as the light dissipates. Ponytail remains horizontal before the character recovers to a neutral stance.
profile.kp7_slash_vfx_rule: The energy burst in Frame 4 aligns perfectly with the forward thrusting motion of the staff head and palms.
